anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After keeps every fact Before kept and moves authority to holds: each report opens with the gate line, carries exactly one [recommended] tag on row 1, keeps stop last, confines raw evidence (run ids, check names, counters) to the show-evidence hint, and places a prose recommendation reason directly above Pick one instead of Before's inline Evidence line and labeled Verdict. Two wording points are worth tightening so neighboring facts don't slip: in Case C, 'your admin rights let you use that override' edges toward the admin-identity phrasing the bypass-merge-pick-revoked fact rejects - prefer 'you are eligible to use GitHub's admin override for this ruleset' - and the Case A/B recommendation sentences are identical ('every requirement is met and GitHub allows the merge'), so consider naming the case's state there too (e.g. 'because this is your own ready PR' / 'because robin's PR is ready and you have merge access') to make 'naming the case's state' unambiguous rather than relying on the paragraph above.
